units.summary: Adds an idempotent setter that appends the new from-selected-series hint to the block meta and sorts the hints. The hint is written into meta.json of persisted blocks.
units.headline: Add setter for new from-selected-series block compaction hint
units.reason: Adds a new persisted hint value to block meta.json that other tools reading block metadata will see.
focus: Consumers of meta.json hints (Thanos/Mimir compactors) tolerate the unknown 'from-selected-series' value

units.summary: Adds a predicate that checks whether the hints contain from-selected-series. It works the same way as FromStaleSeries and is used by the compactor and inOrderBlocksMaxTime.
units.headline: Add predicate checking the from-selected-series hint
units.reason: Simple slices.Contains predicate; its effect comes through callers that are reviewed separately.

units.summary: New unit test covering setting the hint, idempotency, and coexistence with the stale-series hint. It is test-only.
units.headline: Test the selected-series hint setter's idempotency and independence
units.reason: New test only; cannot affect production.

units.summary: Write now copies the FromSelectedSeries hint from the base meta to the output block, as it already does for stale-series. CompactSelectedSeries depends on this to tag its blocks.
units.headline: Compactor Write propagates the selected-series hint from the base meta
units.reason: Changes which hints get persisted on blocks; this affects the in-order maxt calculation.
focus: Leveled compaction merging several blocks does not keep this hint (that path builds meta via CompactBlockMetas), same as stale-series

units.summary: Blocks tagged from-selected-series no longer count toward the in-order max time. They hold only a subset of series and must not move the head's in-order watermark.
units.headline: Exclude selected-series blocks from the in-order max time calculation
units.reason: Changes the watermark that drives head truncation and OOO compaction decisions.
focus: Once these blocks are compacted into higher-level blocks without the hint, they start counting toward maxt, same as stale blocks

units.summary: New test that checks series with OOO data are skipped and stay in the head while the other series is compacted into one tagged block. It is test-only.
units.headline: Test that CompactSelectedSeries skips series with OOO data
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: New test that rewrites a selected-series block through compactor.Write and checks the hint carries over. It is test-only.
units.headline: Test that the selected-series hint propagates through compactor Write
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: New test that checks inOrderBlocksMaxTime reports no in-order block when only a selected-series block exists. It is test-only.
units.headline: Test that inOrderBlocksMaxTime ignores selected-series blocks
units.reason: New test only.
